task: classify dental disease (cavity, periodontitis, periapical infection) from panoramic X-rays
note: Contribution is the CNN IDD-Net; SMOTE-Tomek on 150x150 images of all 670 cases before the split, so test set holds synthetic images. Table 4 loss is categorical cross-entropy, coded log-loss.

task: identify patchouli variety from leaf images
note: Extreme learning machine on 14 handcrafted leaf features (morphology, wavelet, convex hull). Balanced-run accuracies are multiples of 1/70; imbalanced-run test had 28 items (30% of 91). Agriculture coded environment.

task: predict neonatal death from 2022 Kenya DHS survey records
note: Grid search used repeated 5-fold CV; SMOTE placement relative to those folds not described. Reported metrics come from the untouched 25% test set; accuracies sit near the 97.8% no-death base rate.

task: classify corn leaf images into three diseases or healthy
note: Arithmetic hints SMOTE spared the test set: SMOTE-arm test accuracies are multiples of 1/388, as in the original arm (10% of 4768 would be 477); Rule D covers only adverse codes, so nr kept.

task: classify retail customers into high-, medium- or low-value segments for precision marketing
note: Oversampling method never named (coded other). Three customer-value classes labelled from profit rate. Before-split read from step order; test balance follows from it. No no-resampling arm.

task: detect breast cancer from anthropometric and routine blood data (Coimbra)
note: Coimbra data: 64 patients, 52 controls. Test set had 11 items on original data, 12 after ADASYN. 36 learners incl. RUSBoosted Trees; precision/recall/F1 reported only for ADASYN arm.

task: classify a person's emotion from EEG signals
note: Layout hints SMOTE on all ~2100 records before the split (generic tutorial wording), not stated. Data source muddled (DEAP vs OpenNeuro). 'Oversampling and SMOTE' named; only SMOTE described. Medicine arguable for domain.

task: diagnose rolling-bearing fault condition from vibration signals
note: B2: standard DCGAN (4 conv layers, signals reshaped 70x70), no stated change, so application despite 'new DCGAN model' wording. Compared with ROS, RUS, SMOTE; SVM on 13 features. Test balanced by selection, not resampling.
